title: Arlington Fan Events Kick Off Ahead of AT&T Stadium ARIRANG Shows
detail: August 14, 2026 — Dallas-Fort Worth ARMY events begin ahead of BTS's two-night ARIRANG World Tour stop at AT&T Stadium (Aug 15-16). Texas Live! in Arlington opens 'Into the Boraverse,' a partnership pre-concert event with Owl Craft Events running Aug 14-16 with a free Aug 14 pre-party featuring vendors, photo ops, and swag, plus paid days with a live DJ and freebie swaps. Official merch booths open outside Choctaw Stadium, and preordered items become available for pickup at Esports Stadium Arlington (11 a.m.-6 p.m., Aug 14-16). Cupsleeve events run at venues across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex throughout the weekend.

media.caption: Dallas-Fort Worth ARMY fan events, including Texas Live!'s 'Into the Boraverse,' kick off ahead of BTS's Aug 15-16 AT&T Stadium shows.
